units.source_text: 不知到底跑了多远……已经登上好几个斜坡，跑下好几个斜坡了。

en.t: He had no idea how far he had run... he had already climbed several slopes and run down several more.

units.source_text: 他用足力气，憋足劲儿，简直像在梦中一样，白白空耗着力气。

en.t: He used every bit of strength, straining with all his might, wasting his energy in vain as if he were in a dream.

units.source_text: 可现在已无法再谈什么“力的效率”之类的了。

en.t: But by now there was no longer any question of things like the efficiency of force.

units.source_text: 从舌头的深处，涌出掺杂着血腥气的甜味。

en.t: From deep in his tongue, a sweetness mixed with the smell of blood welled up.

units.source_text: 黏乎乎的，想吐也吐不出来。

en.t: It was sticky, and even though he wanted to vomit, he could not bring it up.

units.source_text: 他把手指头伸进去，硬抠着吐了出来。

en.t: He pushed his fingers in and forced himself to gag until he vomited it out.
